headers.Subject:
[PATCH v2 2/2] ASoC: codecs: wsa883x: Use proper shutdown GPIO
 polarity
headers.List-Id:
"Alsa-devel mailing list for ALSA developers -
 http://www.alsa-project.org" <alsa-devel.alsa-project.org>

content:
The shutdown GPIO is active low (SD_N), but this depends on actual board
layout.  Linux drivers should only care about logical state, where high
(1) means shutdown and low (0) means do not shutdown.

Invert the GPIO to match logical value.

Fixes: 43b8c7dc85a1 ("ASoC: codecs: add wsa883x amplifier support")
Signed-off-by: Krzysztof Kozlowski <krzysztof.kozlowski@linaro.org>
